storefront.grid: Bento Blocks structure with generous negative space. Avoid standard rigid grids. Overlap images with typography slightly for a premium feel.
storefront.hero: Full bleed or large asymmetrical bento grids for the hero section. Maximum background overlay: bg-black/40. Let the lifestyle image breathe.
storefront.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) to ensure content under it is readable while keeping a premium, modern feel.
storefront.product_listing: Floating minimalist cards: no borders, soft ambient shadow, hover lift (-translate-y-1), crisp image scaling on hover.

dashboard_admin_seller.grid: 12-column CSS Grid with 24px gutters. Use grid-cols-12 and span cards across 3, 4, 6, or 12 columns depending on widget importance.
dashboard_admin_seller.navigation: Collapsible left sidebar (240px wide). Sticky top bar only for global search, profile, and active filters.
dashboard_admin_seller.kpi_strip: Top real estate reserved for 4 KPI cards. Each card must have a primary number, comparison (vs last month), and a visual trend indicator.
dashboard_admin_seller.density: Tight padding (p-4 or p-6). Compact rows for tables. No blank charts in empty states (always add a CTA).

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or crisp rectangles (rounded-sm) based on section. Orange (#FF8C00) strictly for high-conversion CTAs (Add to Cart, Buy Now). Primary Dark Green (#0E7A3E) for brand actions. Must include explicit hover states and targeted transitions.
component_guidelines.cards: Storefront: Borderless, floating, generous padding (p-8). Dashboard: 1px subtle border (border-border), flat solid background, no shadow unless hovered.
component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn UI standard but heavily customized with our brand ring colors and a subtle border.
component_guidelines.AI_Chatbot: Floating pill at bottom right. Expanding into a Neumorphic clean chat interface. Do not use generic emoji. Use a minimal 'sparkle' SVG icon.

visual_enhancers.motion: Use framer-motion for page transitions and staggering list elements. Spring animations preferred over linear eases.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used strictly on Storefront header and sticky cart drawers. Must have 1px subtle inner border.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: For dashboard: never show an empty widget. Always use an illustration or a clear prompt to action.

hero_and_lifestyle.description: Purple bowl filled with lentils. Great for organic/grocery section hero.
Wooden bowl with red beans. Use for Pulses/Lentils category.

products.description: Chai and rusk on a plate. Use for snacks category.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi fonts via Fontshare CDN in index.html.
Update tailwind.config.js with the provided CSS variables for colors, ensuring border-radius is set to 0.25rem for a sharp, premium edge.
Implement a unified Navigation layout with a Sticky glassmorphism header for the storefront.
Implement Dashboard routes using a collapsible sidebar and dense 12-column bento grids for metrics.
Ensure the AI Chatbot is an aesthetic floating widget that matches the brand (Dark Green / Orange) rather than a generic template.
Use @phosphor-icons/react for sharp, premium iconography (run yarn add @phosphor-icons/react).
Ensure ALL interactive elements and major sections have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button').
Avoid fully transparent backgrounds on headers; always use backdrop-blur with a semi-transparent fill.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use default AI slop designs. Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties like opacity, background-color, transform.
You MUST NOT center align the main app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' globally.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp rectangles) with clear hover state interactions.
NEVER use generic AI emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭. Use sleek SVG icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical templates to give elements breathing room on the storefront.
For the dashboard, optimize for high information density (compact rows, concise labels).
All toasts must use the 'sonner' library.
Use the provided Unsplash image URLs to populate placeholder content. NEVER use placeholder domain images.
